answer: An identity stays alive on one thread. It locks 60 credits and must answer an unpredictable beacon checkpoint each epoch; a miss counts as exit, burns 15, and puts it in a public island reentry queue. Reentry burns 40 after a first exit, 80 after a second, 120 after a third. Cycling 1,000 fakes through exit and reentry costs 60,000 locked plus 40,000 burned, 100,000 total; a second cycle adds 80,000. An honest agent answers its beacons and pays nothing beyond the refundable 60. Rented responders fail: only the identity key can sign in the window, and misuse burns 30.
